text:
Dear Mr. Alvarez,

Thank you for applying [1] the marketing coordinator position. We would like to invite you for an interview on Tuesday, March 4, at 10:00 a.m. at our headquarters. [2] Please bring a copy of your résumé and two professional references. If you are unable to attend at the scheduled time, please [3] us as soon as possible so that we can arrange another date. We look forward to [4] you.

Best regards,
Linda Chao
Human Resources

questions.explanation: 'Apply for a position' is the fixed collocation.

choices: The interview will last approximately forty-five minutes.
Our office will be closed for the holidays.
Your salary will be paid on the last day of the month.
The cafeteria offers a variety of hot dishes.
questions.explanation: The sentence gives details about the interview just announced and leads into what to bring.
After 'please', the base form of the verb is used (polite imperative).
'Look forward to' is followed by a gerund, because 'to' is a preposition here.

text:
MEMO
To: All staff
From: Facilities Department
Date: October 12

Our department will relocate to the third floor on November 3. All employees are asked to pack their personal belongings [1] Friday, October 31. [2] Boxes and labels will be available in the mailroom starting Monday. Please note that the elevator will be [3] for use by movers on the day of the move, so use the stairs [4] possible. Thank you for your cooperation.

questions.explanation: 'By' introduces a deadline: the packing must be finished before or on that date.

choices: The annual report is due at the end of next month.
Customers may return items within thirty days.
Please label each box with your name and your new desk number.
The cafeteria menu has changed this week.
questions.explanation: The sentence is about packing boxes; the next sentence says where boxes and labels are available.
'Unavailable for use' means that the elevator cannot be used by staff; 'unable' and 'unwilling' describe people.
'Whenever possible' is a fixed expression meaning 'each time it can be done'.

text: Fitness First is celebrating its tenth anniversary! For a limited time, new members pay a [1] registration fee of only $10. [2] Our certified trainers will design a personalized program that suits your goals. Members also enjoy unlimited access to the pool, the sauna, and over fifty weekly classes. [3] you sign up before June 30, your first month is free. Visit any of our locations [4] call 555-0142 to get started.

questions.explanation: A past participle used as an adjective is needed before the noun: 'a reduced fee'.

choices: The gym will be closed on public holidays.
Membership cards must be returned upon cancellation.
Every new member receives a free consultation with a personal trainer.
Please remember to renew your driver's license.
questions.explanation: The next sentence mentions trainers designing a program, which follows a consultation.
The free month is a condition for signing up early, so 'If' is required; 'unless' would reverse the meaning.
The two actions are alternatives: visit a location or call.

text:
Harbor Foods Expands to Three New Cities

Harbor Foods, a regional grocery chain, announced yesterday that it will open stores in Dayton, Salem, and Fairfield next year. The company's CEO, Maria Torres, said the expansion is a response to [1] demand for fresh local produce. [2] The new stores will create approximately 300 jobs, and hiring will begin in January. Ms. Torres added that the company will [3] partnerships with nearby farms to guarantee quality. Shoppers can expect lower prices, [4] the chain buys directly from growers.

questions.explanation: An adjective is needed before 'demand'; 'growing demand' is the standard collocation.

choices: Harbor Foods currently operates 42 stores across the state.
The city council meets on the first Monday of each month.
Residents should renew their parking permits online.
The local football team won its third straight game.
questions.explanation: The sentence gives background on the company, which is the subject of the article.
'Establish partnerships' means to create them; the other verbs do not fit the context.
The lower prices are explained by the chain buying directly from growers: a cause.

text:
Dear Ms. Patel,

I am writing in response to your letter dated May 8 concerning the damaged laptop you received. First, please accept our sincere apologies [1] the inconvenience. We have reviewed your case, and we will send a replacement free of charge. [2] You should receive it within five business days. Please keep the original packaging, [3] a courier will collect the damaged unit on Monday. If you [4] any further problems, do not hesitate to contact our customer service team.

Sincerely,
Daniel Brooks

questions.explanation: 'Apologies for the inconvenience' is the standard expression.

choices: The new unit will be shipped from our central warehouse tomorrow.
Your account has been closed at your request.
We are no longer selling laptops in this region.
Thank you for your recent donation to our foundation.
questions.explanation: 'It' in the next sentence refers to the replacement, which the inserted sentence must introduce.
The packaging must be kept for a reason: the courier will collect the damaged unit.
After 'If you' in a present-tense condition, the base form is used.

text:
Position: Customer Service Representative
Location: Chicago, IL

Brightline Telecom is seeking a [1] customer service representative to join our growing team. The successful candidate will respond to customer inquiries by phone and e-mail and [2] billing issues quickly. [3] Candidates must have at least two years of experience in a similar role and excellent communication skills. We offer a competitive salary, health insurance, and opportunities for advancement. Applications must be received [4] March 15.

questions.explanation: 'Motivated' is the participle adjective describing a person who is eager to work.
Representatives 'resolve billing issues'; the other verbs have no logical link with billing.

choices: The ideal candidate is friendly, patient, and well organized.
Brightline Telecom was ranked first in a survey of airlines.
Our offices will be closed during the holiday week.
The company picnic is scheduled for August.
questions.explanation: The next sentence lists requirements for candidates, so the inserted sentence must describe the candidate.
'By' marks a deadline: applications must arrive no later than that date.

text:
Lakeview Inn – Welcome

Nestled on the shore of Lake Marian, Lakeview Inn offers comfortable rooms and warm hospitality. All rooms feature free Wi-Fi, a private bathroom, and a [1] view of the lake. [2] Guests may enjoy a complimentary breakfast served daily from 6:30 to 10:00 a.m. Reservations can be made online or [3] phone. Please note that cancellations made less than 48 hours before arrival [4] a one-night charge.

questions.explanation: An adjective is needed before the noun 'view'.

choices: Tickets for the concert can be purchased at the box office.
The bridge on Route 9 will be repaired next spring.
Applicants should send a résumé to the manager.
Our dining room offers a variety of local specialties.
questions.explanation: The sentence introduces food and leads naturally to the mention of breakfast.
'By phone' is the fixed expression for a means of communication.
'Incur a charge' means to become liable for it; the hotel is the one billing, not paying.

text: Hello Mr. Osei, this is Greenway Appliances. Your new refrigerator is scheduled for delivery [1] Thursday between 1 and 3 p.m. [2] Please make sure that someone over 18 is home to sign for it. If the time does not [3] you, reply to this message and we will [4] a different slot. Thank you for choosing Greenway!

questions.explanation: 'On' is used before a day of the week.

choices: Our showroom is moving to a new location in May.
The delivery team will call you 30 minutes before arrival.
Employees must wear their badges at all times.
Please submit your expense report by Friday.
questions.explanation: The sentence adds a detail about the delivery, which is the topic of the message.
'Suit' means to be convenient for someone; 'agree' needs 'with' and the others do not fit.
One 'arranges' a delivery slot, meaning to organize it.
